Noah Rivera: hello team, first week here. quick question: who do I ping for (1) Dedicated GPU pool provisioning, (2) urgent prod inference latency incidents, and (3) VPC/KMS access for private deployments? also wheres the canonical ownership matrix?

Zara Ahmed: welcome Noah! :wave: Short routing: Dedicated -> eng-platform (open a platform-ops ticket, label `dedicated-request` and tag @helena). Prod incidents -> post in #eng-oncall first and then use the pager flow. VPC/KMS -> security-eng (file support ticket with `private-deploy`). Ownership matrix is in the handbook link below.

Liam O'Connor: For Dedicated tickets we need: team, service, model, steady_qps, peak_qps, p99_target_ms, typical_seq_len, retention_minutes. Minimal example:```team=chat; service=chat-api; model=rdx-6b; steady=12; peak=36; p99=200ms; seq=128``` If this blocks a release, put "deploy-blocker" in the title and mention @helena for fast triage.

Helena Park: extra notes: temporary test quotas can often be granted same-day during business hours. Requests that imply committed spend require finance approval; cc @finance-ops. For incidents: always post to #eng-oncall so the bot can run the PagerDuty escalation.

eng-oncall-bot: Current on-call: Helena Park (week 1912330000). Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-prod. To page: post in #eng-oncall and use `!pager` or call PagerDuty.

Noah Rivera: awesome, thanks. quick follow-up: what's the short checklist for P0 vs P1?

Zara Ahmed: TL;DR: P0 = total outage, >50% customer error rate, or sustained p99 > 2x SLO for >10 minutes -> immediate page and incident. P1 = severe degradation (partial-region impact, p99 1.5-2x SLO) -> notify on-call and open an incident within 15 minutes. P2 = single-customer or non-prod failures -> ticket, escalate only if it grows. Full escalation policy: https://redwood.internal/handbook/incident-escalation

Noah Rivera: filing the Dedicated ticket and access form now. appreciate the help :thumbsup:
